summary: The OVOS skill fleet's own intent corpus, rebuilt from a pinned reproducible pipeline: 208 intents across 40 locales and 24,405 test rows, labelled with the canonical skill ids a real device registers. One row is an utterance and the intent it should fire. Rows are split by how far the phrasing sits from what a fighter trains on — 'id_test' utterances come from the same templates, 'ood' utterances are held-out paraphrases of the same intents, and the ranked metric is computed over the latter.
notes: The OVOS skill fleet's own intent corpus: 208 intents over 40 locales, 24,405 test rows (16,624 id_test, 7,781 ood), rebuilt from a pinned reproducible pipeline. Labels are canonical registered skill ids ('<skill-id>.<author>:<IntentName>'). Rows fall in two buckets: 'id_test' holds surface phrasings generated from the same templates the fighters train on, so it is scored as in-distribution; 'ood' holds held-out paraphrases of the same intents and is what generalization_accuracy is computed over. Both carry a real expected_intent — an 'ood' row is an unseen way of asking for a known intent, not an out-of-scope utterance the engine should refuse. The matching template training corpus is ovos-intents-v5-templates-train; no keyword-paradigm corpus exists for it yet.
